windows.notes: Added drag-and-drop file sending — drop any file onto the chat window to send it. Fixed an installer issue where a newly added plugin's file could be missing.

macos.notes: Added drag-and-drop file sending — drop any file onto the chat window to send it. Unsigned build — right-click the app and choose Open the first time to get past Gatekeeper.

linux.notes: Added drag-and-drop file sending — drop any file onto the chat window to send it. Extract the tarball and run the client_app executable inside bundle/.
